title: BigP3BCI Study F — 6x6 multi-paradigm, 3 sessions (10 healthy subjects)
description: BigP3BCI Study F is a derivative EEG dataset comprising P300-based brain-computer interface recordings from 10 patients with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) across 3 sessions using a 6x6 character grid speller paradigm. The dataset contains 16-channel EEG data sampled at 256 Hz with visual stimulus presentations annotated using HED 8.4.0 schema, designed for P300 event-related potential detection and BCI speller applications. This dataset is derived from the larger BigP3BCI dataset (DOI: 10.13026/0byy-ry86) available on PhysioNet.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 16 channels in standard 10-20 montage at 256 Hz sampling rate. Subjects performed P300 speller tasks with visual stimulus presentations in a laboratory setting. The paradigm involved target and non-target visual events with a trial interval of 0-1.0 seconds, using a 6x6 character grid with online feedback.
